## Video-Catcher 0.3.0: pause, speed slider, tray

- **New:** pause and continue. Every download has **Pause** and **Continue**, the list has **Pause all** and **Continue all**. A paused download keeps what it has and goes on where it stopped, also after a restart. Whether a half download can be continued depends on the site; if a link has expired, it starts again from the beginning.
- **Changed:** closing Video-Catcher during a download no longer throws away what was loaded. The download pauses and goes on at the next start.
- **New:** the window goes into the notification area when you close it while downloads run, and the downloads go on. A click on the icon brings the window back, its menu has **Quit**. Settings, **Close button of the window**: quit, only while downloads run (default), or always.
- **New:** speed slider from 1 to 100 %, for all downloads together, and it works at once, also on running downloads. 100 % is the fastest speed measured while there was no limit; until something was measured, the slider has no effect. For this, yt-dlp sends its downloads through a small relay inside Video-Catcher on 127.0.0.1 (details: README, "What it does on the network").
- **New:** when all downloads are done: quit Video-Catcher, sleep, hibernate or shut down the PC, after a 60 second countdown you can cancel. Holds for this run only.
- **New:** tidy file names, on by default: letters and digits stay, everything else becomes a dot, never two in a row. `Holiday 2026 (Part #2) - Sea.mp4` becomes `Holiday.2026.Part.Nr2.Sea.mp4`. Subtitles and cover pictures next to the video get the same name. The preview shows the name before the download. One tick under the file name turns it off.
- **New:** drag links from the browser onto the window. One link is looked up, several are added straight away; `.txt` files with links and Internet shortcuts work too.
- **Fixed:** a very long link made the window wider than the screen, with the buttons far off to the right. Long links are now shortened in the list and the activity log; the full link is in the tooltip.
- Includes 0.2.1: a stream from the browser extension shows the page title in the list.

Files: `VideoCatcher.exe` (or `VideoCatcher-arm64.exe`) and the extension (`VideoCatcher-extension-chromium.zip`, `VideoCatcher-extension-firefox.zip` or `.xpi`). The extension itself did not change.

The files are not digitally signed yet; Windows SmartScreen may warn. Every file is built by GitHub Actions from this repository, and `SHA256SUMS.txt` lists their checksums.
